harness 'factorio-play': TypeError: FactorioPlayHarness.launch() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tool_interception_url'

audit.root_cause: FactorioPlayHarness.launch overrides NullHarness.launch with a fixed positional signature. verifiers 0.4.0 (the version `verifiers>=0.3.1` resolves to today) now passes a new `tool_interception_url` kwarg, so every rollout raises TypeError. This has nothing to do with our subprocess runtime.
audit.evidence: src/divagr__factorio-play/factorio_play/taskset.py:161 `async def launch(self, ctx, trace, runtime, endpoint, secret, mcp_urls, data):`; pyproject `verifiers>=0.3.1`; rollout.log: verifiers/v1/harness.py:373 `self.harness.launch(` -> `TypeError: FactorioPlayHarness.launch() got an unexpected keyword argument 'tool_interception_url'` (verifiers 0.4.0)
audit.irl_fix: Add `**kwargs` (and forward tool_interception_url) to launch, or pin `verifiers>=0.3.1,<0.4`.
